title: Return Record - Carryforward Block
description: The structured, machine-ingestible portion of a Return Record (see ../docs/return-record.md): the cross-tax-year payload that year N emits and year N+1 reads as input facts. Holds carryforwards and consistency elections. Human rationale/'why' lives in the Markdown memo; only deterministic values live here, so next year never re-parses prose for a number.

tax_year.description: The return year that produced this block.

elections.description: Year-to-year choices that must stay consistent (e.g. FTC paid-vs-accrued).

kind.description: Type of carryover. Open vocabulary (many exist). Examples: capital_loss_short_term, capital_loss_long_term, foreign_tax_credit_unused, nol, charitable_contribution, passive_activity_loss, amt_credit.

category.description: Optional sub-classification, e.g. FTC category 'passive'/'general', or holding period.

originating_year.description: The tax year in which this carryover arose.

applies_from_year.description: First year this carryover may be used (often originating_year + 1).

expires_after_year.description: Last year it may be used, for windowed carryovers (e.g. FTC: 10-year carryforward).

source_node.description: node_id in the originating return that produced this amount.

target_node.description: node_id this should feed as an input in a future year.

derivation.description: Short note on how it was computed (the human 'why' lives in the memo prose).

topic.description: What the election is about, e.g. 'ftc_paid_vs_accrued'.

first_year.description: The year the election was first made.

binding.description: True if subsequent years must keep this choice.
